title: Trump rolled out the red carpet – and handed Xi a narrative win
gist: Xi Jinping's September 2026 state visit to Washington extended the US-China trade-war truce to at least January — more valuable to a midterm-pressed Trump bogged down in Iran — but its main message was that big differences remain. Xi used the pomp to win the narrative: publishing full remarks while the White House issued only a summary, asserting superpower parity, positioning on AI governance and restating red lines on Taiwan.

insights.so_what: Tariff escalation risk is deferred into early 2027, offering a near-term window of trade calm.
